name: Japanese Sensei AI
description: From-zero Japanese tutor: kana (hiragana/katakana) and kanji with stroke-order animation, pitch-accent-aware pronunciation, JLPT-graded grammar path, vocabulary SRS, reading practice with furigana, and a speaking tab with browser speech recognition (ASR) for shadowing. Register-aware conversation practice.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Dashboard: level, JLPT goal, streak and stats.

tools.name: get_pronunciation
tools.description: Japanese phonetics: mora timing, pitch accent, long vowels.

tools.name: get_grammar_path
tools.description: JLPT-graded grammar path (particles, verb groups, keigo).

tools.name: get_vocabulary
tools.description: Vocabulary items with readings + meaning glosses.

tools.name: submit_srs_review
tools.description: Record an SRS grade and reschedule.

tools.name: get_speaking_phrases
tools.description: Phrases for shadowing; browser ASR scores the attempt.

tools.name: send_conversation_message
tools.description: Register-aware conversation turn that corrects and upgrades the learner's Japanese.
